test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct pair of autobiography and related personality from the following.

options.text: The Taste of My Life: Sania Mirza
Dreams From My Father : Vijay Kumar
Straight from the Heart : Barack Obama

solution:
The correct answer is__** Moon Walk: Michael Jackson.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Moon Walk’ is an autobiography of** Michael Joseph Jackson.**
 
• He was born on August 29, 1958 died on June 25, 2009.
 
• Jackson was an **American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist.**
 
• He is known as **"The King of Pop"** and regarded as one of the most significant cultural figures of the 20th century.
 
• Some honors given to Jackson includes:
 
 
• **"Presidential Public Safety Commendation"** award by Ronald Reagan in 1984.
 
• **"Artist of the Decade"** by George H. W. Bush in 1990.
 
• **"Point of Light Ambassador"** by Bush in 1992.
 
 
 
• The RIAA regards him as the biggest-selling music artist of all time worldwide.
 
• Jackson has **13 Grammy Awards, Grammy Legend Award, Grammy Legend Award** and many more awards.
 
• In 2021, he was among the inaugural inductees into the Black Music & Entertainment Walk of Fame.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Sania Mirza:**__

__
 
• **Ace Against Odds** is the **autobiography of Sania Mirza**.
 
• Sania Mirza is an Indian expert tennis player. She came out on top for 6 huge home-run championships in her profession.
 
• The book is her history chronicling her excursion to becoming one of India and **world's top female tennis player**.
 
• The book was released by Shah Rukh Khan at a capability in Hyderabad in July 2016.

**Vijay Kumar:**__

__
 
• The Union Home Minister Rajnath Singh released the book titled **‘Veerappan, Chasing the Brigand’, **written by K. Vijay Kumar, Senior Security Adviser, Ministry of Home Affairs
 
• Vijay Kumar is a former **1975 batch IPS Officer** from the Tamil Nadu cadre.
 
• He headed the prestigious Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy in Hyderabad in 2008 and has also served as the Director-General of Central Reserve Police Force.
 
• He was assigned the job to catch **Veerappan who was a poacher and sandalwood smuggler.**
 
• The book gives an insight into the 20-year long operation (**“Operation Cocoon”**) tasked to catch Veerappan.

**Barack Obama:**__

 
• **"The Audacity of Hope" **is written by former President of the United States, Barack Obama. This book was published in 2006.
 
• He served as the** 44th president of the United States f**rom 2009 to 2017.
 
• He was the** first African-American** to be elected to the presidency.
